latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the "security-testing-strategy" skill for generating security testing strategy documents.
- Guides selection and integration of unit, integration, dynamic analysis, fuzz, and static analysis tests based on secure code review findings.
- Covers practical setup of sanitizers, fuzzing (ClusterFuzz, OSS-Fuzz), and static analyzers tied to CI/CD pipelines.
- Provides clear guidance on mapping vulnerability classes to testing layers and prioritizing coverage for newly identified code risks.
